reportedIssues: The 'Smash Bros Burgers' restaurant card displays '€NaN delivery' as its delivery fee. 'NaN' (Not a Number) is a raw programming error value leaking into the UI, which looks broken and unprofessional and confuses users about the actual delivery cost.

In the 'Fastest near you' row, the third card ('Trattoria Piccol...') and its title are clipped at the right screen edge. While this may be an intentional horizontal-scroll carousel affordance, there is no visible scroll indicator or peek padding cue beyond the cut-off card.
The favorite/heart buttons on the 'Popular right now' cards rely on an icon-only control with no visible text label, which can be ambiguous for screen-reader and assistive-technology users.
